verdict.rationale: Customer.io publishes a dedicated llms.txt (probed live at HTTP 200, with multiple sub-domain llms.txt files like messaging/llms.txt, accounts/llms.txt) explicitly for AI agents, plus agent-oriented docs sections (ai/mcp, ai/cli) and an openapi.json. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration that agents successfully consume these files in practice.
